fusions.name: Uphill Charge
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target and butt it. It deals 15 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Over the Edge
fusions.desc: Butts a target at or below 25% health off its footing. It deals 26 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Roadblock
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 4 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Keeps Climbing
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
